verification_source_schema.source_type: official_operator | official_government | public_map_listing | operator_contact | field_verification | other_authoritative

verification_policy.verified_exact: May only be assigned where independent evidence identifies the actual facility/site coordinate with high confidence.
verification_policy.verified_approximate: May be assigned where independent evidence establishes the correct corridor/locality and the point is useful for navigation/discovery, but the exact facility entrance/site is not proven.
verification_policy.rejected: Used where the Mapbox candidate contradicts credible independent location evidence.
verification_policy.unresolved: Used when there is insufficient evidence to assign a useful coordinate.
constraints: A road match alone is not facility verification.
State match alone is not location verification.
Mapbox alone is not independent verification.

production_mapping_policy.provenance: Provider and verification provenance must remain visible in the data model.
production_mapping_policy.operational_claims: Coordinate verification alone must not imply CNGx verified, live, open, price confirmed, or queue confirmed.
